title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Notice how the y-values change as $$x$$ increases. This can give you a clue about the type of function that might fit the data.

title: Consider the Function Options
text: Think about how each function option (A, B, C, D) transforms the x-values. Which transformation seems to match the pattern of the y-values in the scatterplot?

title: Analyzing Absolute Value
text: What happens to the y-values when you apply the absolute value function to $$x$$?
